note: The numbers of style/BIBLE.md. Ramps are realm ink keys (crates/kiln/assets/realm.hex), dark to light.

outline.selout: each line pixel beside a lit colour takes that colour two ramp steps darker; the line stays 1 px
outline.inner: 1 px where parts or depth break

proportions.note: chibi: big head, short limbs, heavy hands and feet

canvas.pivot: bottom centre, feet on the bottom row

signal.rule: glows, eyes and signature lights only; never a material; unlit

floor.note: the Crypt's plain flagstones (dgn.floor.crypt v1 plain.png)

rubric.silhouette_16: the silhouette reads at grain 1 (16 px a tile): what it is, which way it faces, its weapon
rubric.readability: at true screen size (64 px a tile) the parts separate; values group into big shapes
rubric.palette_light: the realm's inks only, used as ramps; one light from the upper left; shadows one step down their own ramp
rubric.proportions: chibi: the head about 40% of the height at 64 px, short limbs, heavy hands and feet, feet on the floor
rubric.brief_fit: it is what the brief asked for, with the brief's details
rubric.craft: clean clusters, 1 px lines without jaggies or doubled steps, no lone pixels, no pillow shading, no banding, no dither as texture
